entities.name: Torens
entities.description: A human cleric from Hanweir, a former cathar deserter and thief who became a champion of Innistrad's poor peasants wielding a solar mace.

entities.name: Hanweir
entities.description: Torens's home town, later eldrazified and walked away.

entities.name: Gavony
entities.description: Region where Torens is a hero to common folk.

entities.name: Elamon
entities.description: Torens's righteous older brother, a city watch member.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: High city besieged by zombies and skaabs.

entities.name: Odric
entities.description: Commander of the Gavony Riders who spared Torens, later ousted from the Lunarch Council.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: Thraben's guardian who put Torens to work as Mausoleum Guard.

entities.name: Cathars
entities.description: Church order Torens served in for three years.

entities.name: Eruth
entities.description: Mad woman, changed to a wall to be sacrificed, who aids Torens.

entities.name: Traublassen
entities.description: Town where Torens was blackmailed by Lord Vytas.

entities.name: Vytas
entities.description: Lord of Traublassen who blackmailed Torens and was killed by villagers.

entities.name: Aleksandar
entities.description: Local boy abducted and possessed by Umbris.

entities.name: Umbris
entities.description: Entity imprisoned in the keep cellar, bargaining for human sacrifices to remove townspeople's worries.

events.summary: Torens leaves Hanweir after a final confrontation with his brother.
events.quote: he had to leave the town and his sickly mother behind

events.summary: Caught scavenging in besieged Thraben, Torens is spared by Odric and made Mausoleum Guard by Thalia.
events.quote: Thalia put Torens to work as Mausoleum Guard .

events.summary: After Odric's ouster, Torens deserts the cathars with a holy mace.
events.quote: He took a holy mace with him as a souvenir.

events.summary: Torens finds Hanweir eldrazified and gone.
events.quote: Torens was aghast to find Hanweir gone

events.summary: In Traublassen Lord Vytas blackmails Torens into investigating the keep, a trap where Umbris is held.
events.quote: Torens was blackmailed by Lord Vytas to investigate strange occurrences at the old keep

events.summary: Torens frees Umbris from its circle and strikes a deal to return memories and release Aleksandar, vowing to destroy it next time.
events.quote: Breaking the magical circle imprisoning Umbris with his holy mace, he proposed a new deal.

events.summary: Villagers kill Vytas; Torens decides to return to Gavony while Eruth stays.
events.quote: After witnessing the demise of Vytas at the hands of the villagers

relations.note: Blackmailed him and set a trap.
relations.quote: this was a trap set up by Lord Vytas
had imprisoned the creature Umbris in the cellar of the keep

relations.note: Spared him and recommended him to Thalia.
relations.quote: he offered to put in a word with Thalia
